title: BOS-714 — under --host the chat picker renders the remote daemon's chats but drops the local-only [t]erminal action

scenes.title: The chat picker renders remote state but withholds the action that would open a remote path in a local terminal

waitFor.label: the session board is serving the remote daemon's sessions, so the run is genuinely in a --host context and not an empty shell

steps.caption: Boss is driving a daemon on another machine; the session list renders that machine's work.
Open the session's chat picker — the view that offers the per-session actions.

waitFor.label: the chat list header, so the assertions below are read off a rendered chat picker rather than a loading frame

steps.caption: The chat picker lists the remote session's chats.

expect.label: a real chat row from the daemon renders, so the picker is populated and not degraded to an error
attaching to a chat is still offered — --host removes the local-only action, not the ability to open a chat
the actions that still mean something remotely are intact — this is the guard against an empty or collapsed bar, not the [t]erminal assertion, which the regex below carries
a frame that carries the chat picker's own action bar and no [t]erminal on it: the action opens the session's worktree in a LOCAL terminal tab, and that path is on the remote machine

steps.caption: BOS-714: the action bar keeps every action that still means something remotely and drops the one that would open a path that does not exist here.
